results.title: Service healthy before we start
details: /health/live = 200, /health/ready = 200, database up, running version `drill-20261114T135618Z-good`

results.title: HTTPS front door works, /metrics is hidden
details: HTTPS `https://localhost:8443/health/ready` = 200
`/metrics` through the front door = 404 (hidden from the public)
local certificate (made by the proxy itself, so browsers warn about it)

results.title: Many people grab the SAME seat at once
details: 50 clients tried to book seat 5B on trip 1 at the same instant
result: 1 x HTTP 201 (winner, PNR WPMLJ38SGN), 49 x HTTP 409 (clean 'seat taken')
database check: 1 new booking, 1 confirmed ticket for that seat (no duplicate PNR)
response time: median 332 ms, slowest 470 ms

results.title: Cancelling frees the seat for someone else
details: cancelled WPMLJ38SGN, seat 5B became free, rebooked as new PNR WTH3EM7686

results.title: Database dies: detection, alert, recovery
details: database container stopped; `/health/ready` turned 503 after 2.0s while `/health/live` stayed 200
a booking attempt during the outage got a clean HTTP 503 (no crash, no wrong data)
Prometheus alert `DatabaseDown` was FIRING 14.6s after the failure
database started again; service ready after 0.9s with NO restart of the app
data intact: booking WTH3EM7686 is still there (CONFIRMED)

results.title: Backup, total data loss, restore
details: backup `backups/busdb-20261114T140606Z.sql.gz` (5 KB), gzip test and SHA-256 fingerprint OK
verification: a fresh backup restored into a SCRATCH database matched the live data exactly
disaster: every booking deleted (booking WTH3EM7686 returned 404)
restore from backup took 6.9s; booking WTH3EM7686 is back (CONFIRMED)

results.title: A normal release goes live
details: deployed version `drill-20261114T140547Z-good`: built, started, passed the health gate and went live

results.title: A broken release is rolled back automatically
details: broken release `drill-20261114T140547Z-bad` started but never became ready within the 25s health gate
automatic rollback: `drill-20261114T140547Z-good` is serving traffic again (HTTP 200)
deploy history is in `.deploy/history.log`

results.title: App crashes: Docker restarts it by itself
details: app process terminated; Docker restarted the container by itself (restart count 0 -> 1) and the service became ready after 2.4s
